title: A more personal Cirro
summary: New ways to protect your account and get back to the files you need.

items.title: Unlock with biometrics
items.description: Protect Cirro with your Android fingerprint or face unlock. Enable App lock in Settings → Privacy.

items.title: Find recent searches
items.description: Return to recent searches from the search screen. Your history is stored locally and can be cleared whenever you like.

items.title: Request access before signing in
items.description: Google accounts must be approved for Cirro early access. Request approval from the sign-in confirmation before continuing.

items.title: Stay signed in
items.description: Your connected accounts remain available between launches while Cirro refreshes access in the background.

items.title: A refreshed Cirro icon
items.description: The Android launcher now features a cleaner blue cloud icon with a Beta badge.
